hypotheses.H1: Soft-budget filling improves reward vs no soft-budget filling (G_targeted_soft vs G, G_random_soft vs G)
hypotheses.H2: Targeted soft-budget filling improves reward vs random eligible soft-budget filling (G_targeted_soft vs G_random_soft)

G.description: Frozen greedy hard query batch + greedy matching, no soft queries

G_random_soft.description: Greedy hard batch + random eligible soft questions from candidate set C

G_targeted_soft.description: Greedy hard batch + targeted eligible soft questions from candidate set C
